item.title: Using Pride as a Loop Goal: An Experiment Against Metric Rubrics
item.description: An experimental design testing whether Boris Cherny’s “iterate till you’re proud of it” prompt outperforms explicit evaluation rubrics in agent loops.

item.title: Four Operations of Context Engineering and Agent Loop Design
item.description: Break down the four context operations (write, select, compress, isolate), see how they fit inside iterative agent loops like Claude Code, and note verification caveats.

item.title: From Harness Engineering to Loop Engineering
item.description: Compare loop engineering with harness engineering and examine the five operational questions that separate real agent loops from basic workflows.

item.title: Implementing Agent Loop Engineering with Measurable Goals
item.description: Learn how to design autonomous LLM agent loops using measurable Goal definitions, worker-validator separation, and strict maximum turn limits.

item.title: Loop Engineering Tools for Preventing Runaway AI Coding Agents
item.description: Design explicit goals, validation commands, budgets, stop rules, and human approval gates so AI coding agents run safely without infinite loops or cost spikes.

item.title: Four Stages of Agent Loops and Rubric-First Verification
item.description: Compare LangChain’s four loop types, loop-engineering’s staged L1 rollout CLI, and gnomon’s pre-execution rubric validation rules.
